en-US.description:
Murmur is the fastest way to know where your money goes. Say it once and it's filed: "twelve fifty at Chipotle" becomes a categorized expense before your phone is back in your pocket.

No bank logins. No spreadsheets. No forms.

SPEAK, AND IT'S FILED
One tap, one sentence. Murmur hears the amount, the place and the category, in your language, and files it instantly. Income too: say what you earned and it lands on the right side of the ledger.

PAY, AND IT CAPTURES ITSELF
Set up one Shortcuts automation (Murmur walks you through it) and every purchase you make with your iPhone's wallet logs itself: amount, merchant, logo and category, with a quiet notification you can edit in one tap. Even pay-at-pump purchases that report no amount get parked and resolved, never lost.

SEE THE MONTH CLEARLY
Insights shows what you spent, how it compares to last month, where it went by category, and highlights that matter: an upcoming bill, a budget running hot, a purchase that is 8x your usual.

BUDGETS AND RECURRING
Set a budget and watch the daily pace. Recurring bills and income are first-class: Murmur knows what is coming and what is left after it.

14 DAYS OF PLUS, NO CARD
Every new account starts with 14 days of Murmur Plus, no card needed: Ask Murmur, the desktop app, automatic recurring detection and the reports. After that, logging stays free for as long as you want, and Plus is there when you want the whole picture.

ASK MURMUR (PLUS)
Ask anything about your own numbers: "how am I doing against my budget?", "what should I cancel?" Answers come from your data, instantly.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Murmur never connects to your bank. Your voice is turned into text on your phone whenever the device supports it, and audio is never stored. Export everything or erase everything, anytime.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
Murmur syncs across iPhone and the web dashboard at itsmurmur.com. Murmur Plus adds the Mac and Windows apps.

MURMUR PLUS
Logging stays free forever, with 3 Ask Murmur questions a month. Murmur Plus adds unlimited Ask Murmur, your full history and forecast, automatic recurring detection, formatted reports (CSV, PDF) and the Mac and Windows apps, and can be shared with your family through Family Sharing. Monthly or yearly, both with a 7-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and are managed in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Service: https://itsmurmur.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://itsmurmur.com/privacy
en-US.releaseNotes:
New in this version:
• Businesses: keep a farm, a shop or a side gig apart from your personal spending. Give each one its own logo, say "for the farm" when you log, and filter by business.
• Apple Watch: log by voice from your wrist.
• Home Screen widgets: speak or type an expense without opening the app.
• Import your history from a bank CSV or another budgeting app.
• Murmur remembers the category you give a merchant.
• Budgets can roll over what you didn't spend, and you can set savings goals.
• Card charges now show the real store name and logo.
• Fixes and polish.

review.notes: DEMO ACCOUNT: on the sign-in screen tap 'More options' to reveal the email form, then sign in with the credentials above. The account holds sample entries and a monthly budget. CORE FLOW: tap the mic on the Today tab and say e.g. 'fifteen dollars at Starbucks'; the expense files itself. Speech is transcribed by the device (on-device recognition is requested); Murmur never records or transmits audio. NEW IN 1.0.2: Businesses (Settings > Businesses): add one, tap its tile to give it a logo from Photos or one of twelve icons, then say 'for the farm' when logging, or set the Business row when editing an entry. Apple Watch app: nothing to sign in to on the watch; it sends what you say to the iPhone app, which files it in the signed-in account and replies 'Saved'. Home Screen widgets: add Murmur from the widget gallery to speak or type an expense. ACCOUNT DELETION (guideline 5.1.1(v)): Settings > Account > Delete account, and also Settings > Privacy Center > Your data. One confirmation, then the account and every record attached to it are permanently deleted server-side and the app signs out. Please use a new account to try it, so the demo credentials stay valid. DATA EXPORT: Settings > Privacy Center > Export all my data (free for everyone). THIRD-PARTY AI: the app uses OpenAI, called from our own server; the app never contacts OpenAI directly. gpt-4o-mini interprets spoken entries and scanned receipts, gpt-4o answers Ask Murmur. Sent to OpenAI: the transcribed sentence and the user's language, currency, category names and today's date; or the single image the user chose to scan; and for Ask Murmur the user's own transactions, recurring rules, monthly income figure, currency, time zone and typed question. Never sent: name, email address, account identifier, device identifiers, location, contacts, or any photo the user did not choose to scan. Audio is never recorded or transmitted. Requests use HTTPS, content is not used to train models, and none of it is used for advertising or tracking. Disclosed at https://itsmurmur.com/privacy. SUBSCRIPTION: every new account starts with 14 days of Murmur Plus with no card and no purchase, then moves to the free tier. The demo account's 14 days are over, so it is on the free tier, and Settings > Subscription opens the purchase screen: Murmur Plus Monthly and Yearly, auto-renewable, each with a 7-day free trial introductory offer. Free: unlimited logging (voice, typed, scan, Wallet capture), budgets, reminders, this month's insights, 3 Ask Murmur questions a month and the full data export above. Plus adds unlimited Ask Murmur (More > Ask Murmur), full history and forecast, automatic recurring detection, CSV and PDF reports, and the Mac and Windows apps. WALLET CAPTURE is an optional Shortcuts automation the user creates themselves from Settings; it is not needed to review the app. The app is iPhone-only and runs in compatibility mode on iPad.
